correctness.rationale: For nonzero rank-one R=f(.)c the RB equation implies image closure c²=λc, and f∘L_c=(λ/2)f. Writing c=(a,u) with spin multiplication, u=0 contradicts the rank-one equation, and the components force B(u,u)=a². With f(b,v)=sb+phi(v), equality implies phi(u)=0 and s B(u,v)=0 for all v, hence s=0 by nondegeneracy; converse identities establish the full arbitrary char≠2 classification. Quotient by scaling yields the smooth quadric fibration and dimension 2n−2, with q^{n−1}−1 nonzero functionals per F_q point. The standard even/odd-dimensional projective quadric zero-count gives the stated discriminant correction. Independently enumerated all normalized rank-one endomorphisms and checked the defining RB identity on every basis pair for (q,Bdiag)=(3,[1,1]),(3,[1,1,1]),(3,[1,1,2]),(5,[1,2]): counts 8,80,128,24 exactly match formula; finite checks corroborate rather than replace all-field proof.
